collection.title: Citroen Berlingo Twin Rear Doors 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen Berlingo 2018 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE: These wiper blades are only suitable for models which have non-integrated washer jets.
